speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Comedy. I heard the feet. You were at it half the morning, and the floor told me before you did. Sit. I am not putting this dish down to have a plot, but I will have the plot.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Workmen, rehearsing a play in a wood. A weaver who corrects them. He goes off a man and comes back with an ass's head, and he sings to show he is not afraid. A queen wakes and sees him.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And is she punished for it? A queen and an ass is a plot that wants a sentence, if I know a sermon from a play.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have not written the sentence. The page ends when she sees him. I am not giving you an ending I have not got.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then I withhold the verdict. Mark me. I do not rule on a play that has not decided what becomes of her. Comedy, for the feet. The rest can wait until there is an end.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Can it eat? The ass, sir. Last time the jaw was the whole of the trouble. If the jaw does not move, the voice stays in the head. You said so. I only want to know if that is still the answer.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is still the answer. I wrote it on the fourteenth. The jaw must move or the voice will be lost in it. I am not deciding it again over a dish.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then it can eat, if the jaw moves. I can follow that. I am not asking to see the play. Mistress was plain.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: She is not asking to see it. One play was enough for this house. I have not changed my mind because you walked a rhythm into my boards.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The floor carries feet. I heard them too. I do not ask what they were making. A shuttle goes, and a man walks. That is as much as a ceiling owes a neighbour.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then keep it as feet. I am not putting the house into the page, and I am not putting a neighbour into it either.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. I let you the room. I did not let you my maid, my lodger, or my cat, for a wood. Gib has been on the Chaucer again. I moved him once. I will not make a part of that.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave him. A cat on a book is not a scene I need. The letter on the table is not for the house to carry. It waits. I have not named a man to take it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I am not a carrier, and I am not sending Alse out on a frost day to ask. When you name one, the sheet can go. Until then it is a sheet.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I can sand it, if sanding is wanted. I will not read it. I cannot, and I would not if I could, because it is not the dish.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not sand it. It is dry. I am out at Master Field's after dark. Do not keep a supper by the fire for me.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Six is six for this house. You will miss it. Blackfriars can feed you. Eat the pudding now. It will not wait on a weaver.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I go to the loom after this. Norton Folgate, and home again. If your candle is late I will not knock. The morning is enough for news.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No news tonight. A fire, and a page, and home after. The chronicle on the shelf is staying on the shelf.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Master Field's book stays where I can see it is not under a cat. That is my whole interest in chronicles. Comedy. I heard the feet. I have said my verdict, which is that I have not got one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep it. An ending would be a lie at this table, and I have spent the morning not writing one.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will clear the dish and leave the sheet. The sand stays in the box. I had my question about the jaw, and I am not spending a second one.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will be at the loom until the light goes. If a late candle is the only news in the house, it can be news without a knock from me.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Six for us, and no place laid for you. Two facts. They are the only facts this kitchen is offering a weaver.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two facts are enough. I will not be at six. The page will not come to the table with me, and it will not come back as an ending.
